text:
A thermometer has a low thermal capacity.
Why is this an advantage?
A
The thermometer does not absorb much thermal energy to raise its own temperature.
B
The thermometer does not conduct much thermal energy to the surroundings.
C
The thermometer does not melt when it gets hot.
D
The thermometer does not radiate much thermal energy to the surroundings.

options.label: A
options.text: The thermometer does not absorb much thermal energy to raise its own temperature.
